basic_info.description: Welcome home to 360 Day Street, a beautifully updated home in the heart of Noe Valley, one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. This charming residence features 2 bedrooms and 1 remodeled bathroom, blending modern upgrades with classic appeal. The bright kitchen has been fully renovated with new cabinets, sleek countertops, stainless steel appliances, and stylish flooringperfect for cooking and entertaining. Just off the kitchen, a separate eat-in breakfast nook provides the ideal space for casual dining or morning coffee. The bathroom has been refreshed with updated flooring, a modern vanity, and a new shower. A spacious backyard offers a rare opportunity in the city: a blank canvas ready for you to design the garden, patio, or outdoor oasis of your dreams. Located on a quiet street yet moments from the shops, cafes, and restaurants of Noe Valley, this home combines neighborhood charm with city convenience. With easy access to public transit, freeways, and nearby parks, 360 Day Street presents an incredible opportunity to enjoy the best of San Francisco living.
